vulns.description: Flask 2.2.5 is vulnerable to CVE-2023-30861. When using the Werkzeug development server with debug=True, the debugger PIN can be bypassed.
Werkzeug 2.2.3 is vulnerable to CVE-2023-25577. A ReDoS vulnerability in the multipart parsing code.
Jinja2 before 3.1.3 vulnerable to XSS via |urlencode filter.
